---
title: "&#128214; Guestbook &#128214;"
pagetitle: "Guestbook"
description-meta: "Sign the guestbook — say hello to M. Fatih Kara, in the spirit of 1998."
# The one page on the site with comments. Everything else sets `comments:
# false` explicitly, and there is no site-wide default in _quarto.yml, so this
# block turns the guestbook on without touching any other page.
#
# The backend is GitHub Discussions through giscus: entries are posted by
# visitors to the "Comments" category of the site's own repository, which means
# no database, no server and no third party holding anyone's message. It also
# means a visitor needs a GitHub account — the other ways to reach me are in
# the box below for everyone else.
#
# `mapping: pathname` ties the thread to /guestbook/ rather than to the page
# title: the title carries decorative entities and may be reworded, and a
# changed title under `mapping: title` would silently start an empty second
# thread and orphan every entry in the first.
#
# The themes are this site's own, served from assets/geocities/. They have to
# be absolute URLs because the giscus iframe resolves them against its own
# origin; during `quarto preview` they point at a localhost giscus.app cannot
# reach, so the widget falls back to its default light theme until deployed.
comments:
  giscus:
    repo: karamehmetfatih/karamehmetfatih.github.io
    repo-id: "R_kgDOQ3PkWg"
    category: Comments
    category-id: "DIC_kwDOQ3PkWs4DD3GV"
    mapping: pathname
    reactions-enabled: true
    input-position: bottom
    language: "en"
    loading: lazy
    theme: "https://www.mfkara.net/assets/geocities/giscus-salinasvalley.css"
---

::: gc-box
**Thanks for stopping by!!** &#128075;

The book is open &#8212; scroll down, write something, and it appears on this

one click.

**[contact form on the home page](/#contact)** &mdash; that one reaches my

:::
